title: Aye Mere Aoun o Mohd
body:
Qalbe Zainab ki sada hai aye mere aoun o mohd
1. Apni madar se qhafa kyun hogaye bolo zara kis tarah doori sahungi dil nahi pathar mera haye main kaise jiyungi koi batla aye khuda
<<MINI>>
Aye mere aoun o mohd
<<DIVIDER>>
2.
Ab qarar aata nahi hai tum ko mai paoun kahan yaad tadpati hai mujhko do sada aye meri jaan qulb tukde hoo raha hai chaya hai har soo dhuwaa
<<MINI>>
Aye mere aoun o mohd
<<DIVIDER>>
3.
Ayi jab ran se sada aye mamoo jaan ab lo salaam rahe haq me jaan dekar jaa rahe hain tashna kaam ghoonj thi hai ab bhi kaano me sada har shubh o Shaam
<<MINI>>
Aye mere aoun o mohd
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Deen per qurban hookar surq rooh mujhko kiya hasr tak dono ka hai mamnoon deen e mustafa faqr hai baba ko tum par ho yeh maa tum par fida
<<MINI>>
Aye mere aoun o mohd
<<DIVIDER>>
5.
Sunaa sunaa kar gaye ghar aye mere Noor e nazar Karbala ka hai nazara aankhou mein Shaam o saher neend kaise aarahi hai apni maa ko choorker
<<MINI>>
Aye mere aoun o mohd
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Jab musallou par nazar jaati hai roo padhti hoon main
Dil hi dil me naam le le kar fugaah karti hu main baad tum dono ke lamha lamha ab marti hoon mai
<<MINI>>
Aye mere aoun o mohd
<<DIVIDER>>
7.
Aye sohail ashoor ko manzar ghazab ka tha aayaa’n aye jab khaime me lashe choor thi sav pashliyaa’n bain karke rooti thi lashou pe yeh mazloom maa
<<MINI>>
Aye mere aoun o mohd
<<DIVIDER>>
Azz Raza Ali sohail
